name: GDC AI Site Workers
author: GDC Team

sections.description:
GDC AI Site Workers brings AI Website Workers to WordPress.

The plugin helps website owners improve internal linking, discover SEO issues, and manage optimization workflows using safe review-first automation.

Features include:

  • Internal Link Worker
  • SEO Worker
  • CrewPilot Assistant
  • Content Refresh Worker
  • Manual Review Protection
  • Bulk Suggestion Review
  • Smart Anchor Suggestions
  • Campaign Mode
  • Modern AI-style dashboard
  • Safe approval workflows
  • Lightweight admin experience

The plugin is designed with a human review workflow in mind. Suggestions are never automatically applied without administrator approval.

Current Workers

  • Internal Link Worker
  • SEO Worker
  • Content Refresh Worker
  • CrewPilot Assistant

Privacy

GDC AI Site Workers connects to the GDC AI Site Workers API for plugin functionality.

Data sent may include:

  • Site URL
  • Plugin version
  • Store registration information generated by the plugin
  • Installation token generated by the plugin
  • Plan, feature, status, and limit validation requests
  • Content or page data only when an administrator intentionally uses an AI-powered feature that requires remote processing

This data is used to register the installation, validate access, enforce free/pro feature limits, and provide requested plugin functionality.

Service provider: Go Digital Crew
Service URL: https://gdcaicrew.com
Privacy policy: https://gdcaicrew.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://gdcaicrew.com/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gdc-ai-site-workers directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open “GDC AI Site Workers” from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Run your first scan and review suggestions safely before applying changes.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically modify content?

No. Suggestions require manual administrator review and approval before changes are applied.

Does this plugin use external services?

Yes. GDC AI Site Workers connects to the GDC AI Site Workers API to register and validate the site installation, check plan/features/limits, and process AI-powered feature requests where available. See the Privacy section for details.

Is WooCommerce supported?

Yes. WooCommerce products and content can be included in scans.

Will more workers be added later?

Yes. Additional AI Website Workers are planned for future updates.
